name: Dielman Edward Kolb
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Earliest known ancestor of the Kulp/Kolb line. Also spelled Kolb. Brendan's ancestor via Kulp/Simons/Adams branch.
Irma notes the family surname appears as Kolb, Kolp, Culp and Kulp; the lineage list came from Patricia Kenoyer and is not backed by legal papers. [Family research emails, email 23]
Unconfirmed: Dielman Edward Kolb is thought to be buried in Manheim in the Palatinate. [Family research emails, email 23]
